+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a contact book: name, phone, email, group Family/Friends/Work, search by name, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores contacts. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/contacts call them. A single HTML page lists contacts with coloured group badges, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Contact book
+
+Store and manage your contacts with names, phone numbers, emails, and groups.
+
+**contacts**: name (string), phone (string), email (string), group_name (Family / Friends / Work). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add a contact with name, phone, email, and group
+- List of contacts showing name, phone, email, and group with a coloured group badge
+- Search by name to filter the list
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every contact
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/contacts`: Add a contact
+- `GET /api/contacts`: List all contacts
+- `PUT /api/contacts/{id}`: Edit one contact
+- `DELETE /api/contacts/{id}`: Delete one contact
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with name, phone, email, and a group select (Family, Friends, Work) and a Save button
+- List of contacts showing name, phone, email, and a coloured group badge
+- Search input to filter the list by name
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every contact
+- Show error messages from the API
